messages:
Maya (Sales): Heads-up — Equinox signed term sheet contingent on a capacity plan: reserved GPUs, autoscale behavior, preheat, cross-AZ failover. They need a customer-ready one-pager by Mon.
Leo (Solutions Eng): Got it. quick clarifying Qs: target p95/p99 latency and steady vs peak qps?
Maya (Sales): p99 < 300ms for short chat completions. steady 350 qps, peaks to ~1.2k for ~10min bursts a few times daily. nightly batch embeddings ~2k reqs/min. Cross-AZ redundancy required; prefer Dedicated us-east with hosted fallback.
Priya (Infra): Proposal sketch: mirror reserved pools across two AZs (3 GPUs each, total 6 reserved). Keep min active 3, scale within reserved to 6, allow burst to 8 using reserved burst credits. Sticky routing by AZ; failover to sibling AZ, then hosted.
Leo (Solutions Eng): I ran a quick perf job on their sample (job id eqx-1773): rdx-embed-1.0-q4 => ~3800 emb/s per GPU (batching), p95 ~90ms. For embeddings steady pool 4 GPUs recommended; add +2 GPUs for promo bursts. Chat model rdx-chat-small-q4: ~700 qps per GPU (short chats), p95 ~220ms — so 2 GPUs for latency headroom.
ops-bot: perf job eqx-1773 completed.
Priya (Infra): Autoscale YAML draft: 
```
autoscale:
  min_gpus: 3
  max_reserved: 6
  max_burst: 8
  scale_up: queue_depth>200 for 90s
  scale_down_cooldown: 300s
```
Maya (Sales): Pricing ask: they want a single monthly committed number for reserved + burst included as usage. We normally do base monthly for reserved + usage for burst. Can we present both and a blended option?
Leo (Solutions Eng): Yes. I'll prepare a cost table (reserved 6 GPUs monthly, burst billed hourly above baseline), and include preheat ops: nightly warmup + cron 15min before promos. Warmup example snippet: `for p in $(cat hot-prefixes.txt); do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rdx-chat-small-q4","input":"'$p'"}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate >/dev/null; done`
Priya (Infra): Security: Dedicated supports KMS/HSM and per-request audit logs — include in SOW. Also note SLA: we can offer 99.9% for Dedicated pools with scheduled maintenance windows.
Maya (Sales): Great. Can you both drop a 1-pager (pool counts, perf bullets, autoscale YAML, preheat schedule, failover bullets, pricing options) into this thread by tomorrow morning?
Leo (Solutions Eng): On it.
Priya (Infra): I'll attach AZ topology sketch and failover notes.
ops-bot: action created: eqx-capacity-handoff (owner: Leo). due: 48h.
